# Sukoon Properties

A professional real estate and housing application built with Flutter.

## About

Sukoon Properties provides safe, trusted and modern housing solutions.

The application supports:

- Android
- iOS
- Web


## Features

- Property Listing
- Property Details
- Search
- EMI Calculator
- Director Profile
- Company Information
- Modern UI Design
- Responsive Web Support


## Technology

Built with:

- Flutter
- Dart
- Material 3 Design
- GitHub Actions
